title: Field-ready sales activation brief for Redwood Optimize cost controls
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a compact, field-ready activation brief and collateral set that equips account execs and CS to (1) articulate Redwood Optimize value (cost/perf tradeoffs), (2) run two-minute demo scenarios, and (3) handle common procurement and technical objections. Scope includes one-pager, battlecard, FAQ, objection-handling script, 8–10 minute recorded demo, two short live demo flows with sample prompts, and a customer ROI worksheet template. This ticket coordinates content owners, release notes entries, and distribution timing (pre-announce -> enablement session -> live campaign). Stakeholders: Product (Priya), PMM (Lina Thompson), Sales Enablement (Diego), Solutions Eng (Markus Chen), Design (Asha Kumar), Runtime Eng owner (ENG-6123). Success metrics: enablement NPS >= 8 in session feedback, 75% of active AEs mark collateral as "ready to use", two closed deals that reference ROI worksheet within 30 days of launch.
acceptance_criteria: One-pager PDF + copy for email with approved messaging
Battlecard (one page) covering 5 use cases, 3 objection scripts, and competitive signals
FAQ doc with release-notes references and 6 technical answers for SEs
Recorded demo uploaded and trimmed (8–10m) with transcript and timestamps
Two live demo flows documented with sample prompts and expected outputs
ROI worksheet (spreadsheet) and sample filled example
Enablement slide deck and 60-minute session scheduled with recording link
